flags.text: INPE PRODES maps 89 ha of deforestation inside this ranch after the EUDR cut-off (31 Dec 2020). Cattle raised here cannot enter the EU and large clearings are rarely licensed.
flags.title: 89 ha cleared after 2020

flags.text: The ranch boundary overlaps 3 ha of the Kayapó Indigenous land, where cattle ranching is illegal.
flags.title: 3 ha inside an Indigenous land
